description: This file defines a static class 'ReferencedAssemblyProvider' that provides methods to gather relevant assemblies in an Orleans serialization project. It handles assemblies loaded through different contexts, such as DependencyContext, AssemblyLoadContext, and AppDomain, focusing on those marked with 'ApplicationPartAttribute' and those related to Orleans.Serialization. It includes logic for different .NET versions (NETCOREAPP3_1_OR_GREATER, NET5_0_OR_GREATER) to handle assembly loading specifics.

classes.name: ReferencedAssemblyProvider
classes.description: A static class providing methods to retrieve and process assemblies pertinent to Orleans serialization, handling different loading contexts and filtering based on attributes.

methods.name: GetRelevantAssemblies
methods.description: Returns all assemblies relevant to Orleans serialization, collected from the current AppDomain, DependencyContext, and AssemblyLoadContext.

methods.name: AddAssembly
methods.description: Adds an assembly to the set if it has the 'ApplicationPartAttribute' and recursively includes its referenced application parts.

methods.name: AddFromDependencyContext
methods.description: Loads and adds assemblies from a dependency context, focusing on those related to 'Orleans.Serialization'.
